title: jobs settings
description: Operator settings for the jobs module (company.yaml modules.jobs). Secrets (admin token, hash key, webhook secret, encryption keys) are never settings; can-core generates them as Secrets.

approval_required.description: A job needs an approved requisition before it can open.

collect_eeo.description: Show the voluntary diversity questions on the apply form. Whether collecting them is lawful or required is the operator's decision (docs/recruiting.md).

retention.description: Retention in days, counted from the last decision on a candidate's applications. Review against local law; the defaults are not advice.
